notes.title: STEAM SALE: Box Pushing Fest DEMO
notes.content:
We've had so much fun participating in Steam's Box-Pushing Festival this week! For those of you who are unfamiliar, the titular 'Sokoban' in our game's title is the same box-pushing puzzle mechanic being highlighted in Steam's most recent sale. 

[h2]Box-Pushing Fest[/h2]
Steam has many interesting games and demos highlighted during this event, and we are just one of the many games available to download! Some other puzzle games we've enjoyed playing during the festival include:

🌟 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900760/SokoPenguin/]SokoPenguin Demo[/url]
🌟 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2724860/Zen_Garden/]Zen Garden Demo[/url]
🌟 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628610/Paquerette_Down_the_Bunburrows/]Paquerette Down the Bunburrows Demo[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576879/31770df7ffabe62f03c8fffbe2352a93061d747e.png[/img]
[code]This Fest is for puzzle games that are about pushing things, also known as the Sokoban (“warehouse keeper”) genre. These games are all about pushing things around a limited space until you solve the puzzle.[/code]

[h2]So, How is Our Game a Sokoban?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576879/7d0bfcd3358f6029d02ed0976d91320f6f0b6d20.png[/img]
In Celestial Sokoban, the "boxes" are starbursts scattered across each level! You control a Star Child, who can move along the grid-lines, and upon hitting a starburst, will push it to the next intersection on the grid.

You as the player must navigate this grid (we call it an 'orbital map') in order to push each starburst into their proper position to form constellations to complete each level.


[i]If you are interested in learning more about sokoban/box-pushing puzzle gameplay, take a look at [url=http://www.sokobano.de/wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page]the sokoban wiki here[/url]![/i]

notes.title: DEMO v0.1.2 [Steam Achievements] FREE Content Update
notes.content:
Thank you so much to the many players who have enjoyed Celestial Sokoban so far! We're here to give a quick update on development progress and give everyone access to the DEMO Beta v0.1.2!

[h2]UPDATE v0.1.2: Steam Achievements & Hotfix[/h2]

Steam Achievements have arrived in Celestial Sokoban! We're still new to the Steam Achievements system so there are 7 achievements to start. Do you think you can collect them all?

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3588610#scrollTop=0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576879/b754443a6e0afe58b19c33d5402cd47ab0ea4329.png[/img][/url]

[b]v0.1.2 Changelog:[/b]
🔹 Basic Steam Achievements implemented
🔹 Added descriptive level names to individual levels & level select
🔹 Modified minor level layout details to prevent early gameplay soft-locking 
🔹 Fixed DEMO completion screen to be accessible from Star-2 level select
🔹 Fixed small animation issues with star child idle/push
🔹 DEMO app icon changed from default Godot Engine > Celestial Sokoban
🔹 Removed "debug" title in application name when running

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588610/Celestial_Sokoban/

notes.title: Celestial Sokoban Playable DEMO
notes.content:
[h2]Celestial Sokoban BETA v0.1.0[/h2]
ITS HERE!!! Celestial Sokoban has a free playable DEMO for everyone to enjoy!

We're so excited to show players our game that we decided to release a short demo to let people experience the game early! While this is still a beta version, we'd love to hear feedback from puzzle game players on the current version on what we could add or improve to make the game a more polished experience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588610/

[h2]Feedback and Questions[/h2]

If you have feedback or questions, you can always make a comment on the Celestial Sokoban Community Forums where we (and other players!) can read what you've written!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3588610]View the Community Page Here!
[/url]

We've included the following sections in the forum for easy organization:

🌟 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3588610/discussions/0/]I'm Stuck[/url] [i](come here for help on difficult levels)[/i]
🌟 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3588610/discussions/2/]Feature Request[/url] [i](have a cool idea for a feature or accessibility option? discuss here!)[/i]
🌟 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3588610/discussions/1/]General Discussion[/url] [i](for all other things Celestial Sokoban related)[/i]
